# Upgrading

Page-level metadata only — no `graph` block. The harvest rule (ADR 01024) feeds
this document's graph from the page's own fields: `type` derives the iiRDS
topic type, `applies-to` mints the product variant (here in single-string
shorthand), `concepts` becomes the subject, and `supersedes` becomes the
revision edge to [the getting started guide](getting-started.md).
